_doc: Bundle of every MintConfig a Holder should be whitelisted on. whitelist-wallet.ts iterates every pool, then every entry within, and emits one ix per MintConfig that doesn't already have a whitelist PDA on-chain. Add new MintConfigs here whenever a new wrap-token / withdraw-ticket pair ships so retail + institutional + playground stay in lockstep.

mintConfigs.label: csSOL
mintConfigs.comment: Primary wrap-token MintConfig — pinned by pool_config.dm_mint_config; whitelisted via the standard add_participant_via_pool path.

mintConfigs.label: csSOL-WT
mintConfigs.comment: Withdraw-ticket MintConfig — owned by the same pool PDA but lives outside pool_config.dm_mint_config, so requires the wt-specific governor ix added in 2026-05.

mintConfigs.label: cSOL
mintConfigs.comment: KYC wrapper around wSOL. Uses the native_pool seed shape (governor's add_participant_native_via_pool ix) — earlier the bundle was set to addParticipantViaPool, which derives the pool PDA from ["pool", underlying_mint] and trips ConstraintSeeds 2006 against the native pool's actual PDA derived from ["native_pool", wrapped_mint]. Now it's collateral in EG-3 (long SOL), debt in EG-4 (short SOL), AND debt in EG-2 (LST/SOL — replaced wSOL after 2026-05-06 migration). All three flows route through delta-mint's whitelist gate, so every Holder needs this entry.
